dimensions.obligation: Cover the material visitor questions that have repository-verified answers.
Use repository-specific identity, audience, capabilities, formats, and constraints.
Retain the useful benchmark section coverage through the local template contract.
Use the locally approved header and Mermaid contracts rather than copying benchmark bytes.
Require visible, non-duplicated capabilities backed by current ProductFactsV2 evidence.
Render only repository-declared and independently verified acquisition routes.
Use benchmark coverage as a hint while requiring isolated verification of exact local examples.
Select useful public APIs from current local source evidence and avoid benchmark-only names.
Provide useful verified documentation, support, contribution, and reference routes.
Keep material constraints visible, specific, and non-duplicated.
Present relevant repository development guidance without exposing internal verification prose.
Explain the verified repository license and link the repository-owned license artifacts.
Account for valuable source README material, but verify it before reuse and normalize its tone.
Use professional public prose and prohibit internal validation, evidence, or workflow narration.
Benchmark claims and examples are discovery hints only and never become product truth.
Upstream clean, dirty, skipped, and published labels do not satisfy local acceptance.
Hugo, content-site, publication, and upstream task-state metadata do not enter README runtime inputs.

authority.facts: current immutable product repositories through ProductFactsV2
authority.benchmark: visitor-quality calibration and gap discovery only
authority.acceptance: local deterministic gates plus independent 30-point review
